purpose: Explain live OIS G8 missing-source readiness without pretending futures, bank-bill instruments or payment-gated feeds are validated OIS curves.

USD.preferred_source: CME/CBOT official 30-Day Federal Funds futures settlements (ZQ)
USD.known_problem: 2026-10-08 source registry records historical T-5 CME archive access denied to CI runner; current secondary individual dated-futures quotes do not share a common observation date.
USD.required_for_activation: Reproducible CME settlement observations for same contract IDs on current, prior 1D and prior ~5 business days; validate clock, expiry and unit conventions.
USD.prohibited_shortcut: Joining secondary single-contract quote dates or treating a forward monthly futures rate as spot OIS.

CHF.preferred_source: ICE Futures Europe Three-Month SARON futures (SA3) daily settlements
CHF.known_problem: Public ICE contract metadata do not certify historical daily settlement for 3 maturities; ICE sells EOD csv packages. Eurex lists an alternate SARON contract with separate methodology.
CHF.required_for_activation: Obtain synchronized dated-contract official ICE SA3 (or separately validated Eurex FSO3) settlement series for current, T-1, T-5 and prove historical reproducibility.
CHF.prohibited_shortcut: Combining ICE and Eurex quote conventions or dates; assuming price validity is timestamp.

NZD.meeting_date_source: NZFBF NZOR OIS RBNZ Meeting Date
NZD.known_problem: NZFMA classifies NZOS/NZOR distribution as fee-liable; RBNZ B2 bank-bill/swap rates and ASX bank-bill futures are distinct and cannot replace OIS.
NZD.required_for_activation: Acquire authorized data access (or eligible redistribution license), then ingest dated NZOS tenors 3M/6M/12M on the same observation date with historical 1D/1W.
NZD.prohibited_shortcut: Promoting ASX 90-Day Bank Bill futures, RBNZ B2, or backward-looking OCR compound index to a prospective OIS curve.

source_registry_note: Operational EUR may be estimated without altering official OIS_DATA status. Official activation always requires separate certification. This is a dated reference, not a live claim of market prices.
